```lean
by
  have h_b_ge_3 : b ≥ 3 := hb
  have h_a_gt_b : a > b := ha
  have h_ab_eq_12 : a * b = 12 := h
  have h_b_le_3 : b ≤ 3 := by rw [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq]; exact Or.inl (le_of_gt hb)
  have h_b_eq_3 : b = 3 := by cases h_b_ge_3 with h_b_ge_3; cases h_b_le_3 with h_b_le_3; exact Nat.eq_of_le_eq h_b_ge_3 h_b_le_3
  have h_a_eq_4 : a = 4 := by rw [h_b_eq_3] at h_ab_eq_12; exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_left h_ab_eq_12 (Nat.succ_pos 3)
```
